diagnostic_threshold_scope: Reporting convenience only, not an acceptance, reader-qualification, or physical-object gate.
sampling: Identical sample_segments at voxel_size/2; the sampled_points representation concatenates those samples with the unchanged original points and supplies no segments.
freeze_policy: Freeze generated unlabelled normal inputs, separately stored construction truth, reader defaults, all local evaluation sources and related tests before any normal output. Complete all 176 rows before truth-file access. No fixture replay or post-score threshold selection.
development_context: Prior fixture failures informed the design. These 44 conditions have not been scored before this freeze; authored analytic controls are not blind independent physical objects. Both phases and both scales repeat the same 11 construction families.
qualification: Construction-conditioned analytic geometry only. Positive abstention is missing recovery, not success. Empty negative output is only construction-conditioned rejection, not foreground recognition. Preserve all errors, unresolved states and regressions. Not a general reader qualification or G1 pass.
